node.title: Re: Unable to install Perl Module
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Based on a grep of CPAN, I'm assuming you're talking about [mod://Math::Pari] (Update before posting: [id://1219177|yep]). This issue appears to have been reported as [rt://125893|#125893] and [rt://82669|#82669]. The first of those appears to contain a patch which you could try.
